Musiqay radio sources and original station artwork
Last reviewed: 2026-11-17

Station names/logos belong to their respective broadcasters. Musiqay is an
independent player. Remote links are refreshed separately through
config/radio-catalog-v1.json so broken curated routes can be replaced without
shipping a new APK.

Religious / spoken audio
------------------------
Quran Stations / Qurango:
https://qurango.net/
Used for Ruqyah, morning adhkar, evening adhkar and Sakeenah streams.

Nasr El Din Tobar archive:
https://www.nourelquran.com/
The 21 Tobar items are recorded archive audio, not LIVE radio. Remote catalogue
marks them isLive=false. The provider may temporarily put individual audio
services into maintenance, so playback errors must be presented as recording
source failures, not live-radio failures.

Directory
---------
Community catalogue: Radio Browser, https://www.radio-browser.info/
API instructions: https://docs.radio-browser.info/
Musiqay requests countrycode EG with hidebroken=true and lastcheckok=1.
Directory data refreshes every 6 hours in 1.4.9. A healthy-directory flag is
not a guarantee of uninterrupted listening.

Content exclusion
-----------------
Mishary Rashid Alafasy / مشاري العفاسي variants are blocked from curated,
remote, retained and Radio Browser catalogue content by application rules and
the remote catalogue block list.
